steps.name: Access and Pneumoperitoneum
steps.description: Establishment of pneumoperitoneum and insertion of trocars.
steps.teaching_point: Always verify safe entry to avoid bowel or vascular injury.

steps.name: Exposure of Calot's Triangle
steps.description: Retraction of gallbladder to expose the hepatocystic triangle.
steps.teaching_point: Critical view of safety must be obtained before clipping.

steps.name: Dissection of Cystic Duct and Artery
steps.description: Isolating the cystic duct and artery from surrounding tissue.
steps.teaching_point: Misidentification of the common bile duct is the most catastrophic error.

steps.name: Clipping and Division
steps.description: Placement of surgical clips on the cystic duct and artery and division.
steps.teaching_point: Ensure clips are secure and no other structures are caught in the clip.

steps.name: Gallbladder Dissection from Liver Bed
steps.description: Separating the gallbladder from the liver bed using electrocautery.
steps.teaching_point: Maintain correct tissue plane to avoid liver injury and excessive bleeding.

steps.name: Extraction and Closure
steps.description: Removal of gallbladder in an endocatch bag and closure of port sites.
steps.teaching_point: Careful extraction prevents bile spillage and port-site infection.
